title: The gate, open
logline: The logging road's gate — chained since the strip started drawing it — open, the chain on the ground, the padlock beside it unlocked. Who opened it, the page doesn't say. The glow past it, farther up. The man and the dog on this side, not yet through.

panels.composition: A steel gate across a logging road standing open, its chain on the gravel with an unlocked padlock, a man in plaid from behind and a small three-legged dog on the near side not yet through, a warm glow up the road between the trees.
